info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Disbursement Id-spec
info.description: The Operational Services Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about operational services associated with a specific disbursement ID. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and banking applications that need to query service records based on unique disbursement identifiers. Typical consumers include developers integrating financial services and analysts retrieving operational data for reporting purposes. The API streamlines the retrieval of service information, ensuring accurate and efficient access to critical banking data.

get.summary: Fetch a specific disbursement by ID.
get.description: Retrieve detailed information about the disbursement with the specified ID. This endpoint allows you to access relevant data related to the disbursement, including status, amount, and associated entities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the disbursement operation identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request complies with the schema defined in the operations specification.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested resource details.

GetOperationalServiceByDisbursementIdReq.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to disbursement services in the operational environment.
